section_summary: This section (pages 81–160) of decimal file 894.111 covers State Department and War Department processing of individual entry permits and travel clearances for occupied Japan and Korea in late 1947 and early 1948. The documents concern foreign businessmen under the U.S. Traders Quota, commercial representatives, diplomatic and international conference delegates from Pakistan and Burma, and Christian missionaries. The papers illustrate inter-agency procedures between the Division of Protective Services, the Department of Commerce, and the Army's Military Permit Section under SCAP Circular No. 8 policies.
